head: codex/5825-birthday-contract
title: [v0.92][WP-08] Implement deterministic birthday contract
body:
Closes danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5825

## Summary
- add a deterministic Runtime v3 birthday decision contract
- reject lifecycle lookalikes, incomplete or contradictory evidence, unsafe/private paths, packet drift, and prohibited public claims
- retain positive and table-driven negative fixtures plus truthful birthday non-claims
- correct native receipt validation for the canonical Agent Logic repository

## Validation
- exact `birthday` nextest target: 6/6 passed
- strict Clippy and formatting: passed
- receipt producer and validator Ruby syntax: passed
- typed C-SDLC validation and exact-head review: passed

## Review
Independent exact-head review approved the product and digest-bound local evidence with no actionable findings. Native macOS/Linux portability receipts remain explicitly deferred to their CI producer lanes and are not claimed by local proof.
